misconceptions.name: 把卖东西当成分享
misconceptions.why: 只看到东西给了别人，就想到 share，没注意 Tom 收了钱。
misconceptions.move: 追问：东西给出去，Tom 拿到钱了吗？拿东西换钱是 sell，不要钱分给别人才是 share。

misconceptions.name: 把 sell 和 buy 弄反
misconceptions.why: 两个词都和买卖有关，只记住了“和钱有关”，没分清钱是进来还是出去。
misconceptions.move: 画箭头：东西出去、钱进来是 sell；钱出去、东西进来是 buy。

misconceptions.name: 辅音后的 l、r 分不清
misconceptions.why: 汉语里没有 cl、cr 这样两个辅音连着读，l 和 r 又都靠舌头发音，听着差不多。
misconceptions.move: 成对读 clean—cream、glass—grass：读 l 时舌尖顶住上齿后面，读 r 时舌尖不碰任何地方。

misconceptions.name: 只读首字母，漏了第二个辅音
misconceptions.why: 认读时只看开头一个字母，把 cr、gr 这类组合里的第二个辅音丢了。
misconceptions.move: 圈出开头两个字母，先慢读 c—r，再连起来读，比一比 car 和 cry。

misconceptions.name: 把 Why not…? 当成问原因
misconceptions.why: Why 学成“为什么”，就逐词理解，没把“Why not + 动词”当成提建议的句型。
misconceptions.move: 把 Why not take a bus? 换说成 Let's take a bus. 问：两句意思一样吗？

misconceptions.name: 看到 not 就以为叫人别做
misconceptions.why: Don't… 说惯了，看到 not 就当成“不要”。
misconceptions.move: 追问：说话人希望大家坐公交还是不坐？Why not 后面的动作正是她建议做的事。

misconceptions.name: 把 Dear 后的人当成写信人
misconceptions.why: 信的第一行就是名字，以为写在最前面的就是写信的人。
misconceptions.move: 在信上标出：Dear 后面是写给谁，Your friend 下面是谁写的。

misconceptions.name: 把信里提到的人当成写信人
misconceptions.why: 没弄清信里的 my、I 指写信人，就抓了正文里出现的名字。
misconceptions.move: 圈出正文里的 my，问：my crayons 是谁的蜡笔？再看信末的署名。

misconceptions.name: 把 dr 和 tr 读成一样
misconceptions.why: t、d 舌头位置一样，没注意读 d 时喉咙在振动。
misconceptions.move: 手摸喉咙读 t 和 d，再读 tree、dream 的开头，感觉哪一个在振动。

misconceptions.name: 看到 sand 就选海滩
misconceptions.why: 海边的沙滩最常见，没看后面“没有海、很少下雨”这些线索。
misconceptions.move: 把描述里的线索一条条圈出来去对：沙滩旁边有没有海？

misconceptions.name: 把草原和沙漠的词记混
misconceptions.why: 两个词都指一大片空旷的地方，只记住了“很大、很平”。
misconceptions.move: 拆词：grass + land 是长满草的地；desert 是沙子多、雨很少的地方。

misconceptions.name: 照“有……长”用了 has
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“这条河有 900 千米长”，就把“有”译成 has。
misconceptions.move: 对比：说长度用 is，is 后面依次放数字、单位、long。

misconceptions.name: 三者以上比较用了比较级
misconceptions.why: -er 说得熟了，没注意是和全镇所有的树比。
misconceptions.move: 问：和几样东西比？两样比用 -er，三样及以上比出“最”用 the -est。

misconceptions.name: 说“感兴趣”漏了 be
misconceptions.why: 汉语“他对地图感兴趣”里没有“是”，就把 interested 当成动词直接用。
misconceptions.move: 把 is interested in 当成一个整块读三遍，再换主语说 I am… / They are…

misconceptions.name: 把发明者说成发明物
misconceptions.why: invention 和 inventor 只差词尾，记住了“发明”就混着用。
misconceptions.move: 问：空里要填的是人还是东西？人用 inventor，东西用 invention。

misconceptions.name: 说步骤的动词加了 s
misconceptions.why: 三单加 s 练得多，看到一句话说一个动作，就给动词加 s。
misconceptions.move: 问：这句是在叫谁去做？说步骤是在叫“你”做，动词用原形放在句首。

misconceptions.name: 说步骤的动词用了 -ing
misconceptions.why: 想着手工“正在做”，就用了 -ing。
misconceptions.move: 把步骤读成叫人做事：Draw a flower! 说步骤和叫别人做事一样，用原形开头。

misconceptions.name: 把头疼、牙疼的词记混
misconceptions.why: 两个词都有 ache，只记住了“疼”，没看前半部分是哪儿疼。
misconceptions.move: 拆词：head（头）+ ache，tooth（牙）+ ache，让学生指着身体部位说。

misconceptions.name: 把 may 都当成“可以”
misconceptions.why: May I…? 最先学，以为 may 只有“可以”一个意思。
misconceptions.move: 对比 May I come in?（可以吗）和 It may rain.（可能），问：下雨需要谁同意吗？

misconceptions.name: 把“可能”读成“一定”
misconceptions.why: 只读出了“会咳嗽”，没注意 may 表示说不准。
misconceptions.move: 把句子里的 may 分别换成“也许”和“一定”读一读，问哪一句说得太死。

misconceptions.name: the UK 漏了 the
misconceptions.why: China、Canada 前不加 the，就以为国家名前都不加。
misconceptions.move: 把 the UK、the USA 写在一起读：名字里有 Kingdom、States 的要带 the。

misconceptions.name: 所有国家名前都加 the
misconceptions.why: 记住了 the UK，就以为国家名前都要加 the。
misconceptions.move: 分两栏读：the UK、the USA / China、Canada、France，大多数国家名前不加 the。

misconceptions.name: 看到形容词就用 How
misconceptions.why: 记住了“How + 形容词”，没看形容词后面还有名词。
misconceptions.move: 圈出感叹的部分：形容词后有名词用 What a，只有形容词用 How。

misconceptions.name: 把 won't 当成“不想”
misconceptions.why: won't 和 want 拼法、读音都像，就以为是 want 的否定。
misconceptions.move: 写出 will not → won't、do not → don't，再把 won't 换回 will not 读整句。

misconceptions.name: 以为 won't 来自 would
misconceptions.why: will 和 would 都以 w 开头，缩写后分不清是哪一个。
misconceptions.move: 对比：would not → wouldn't，will not → won't，两个缩写长得不一样。

misconceptions.name: 照汉语把数放在 long 后面
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“长约 900 千米”，“长”在数字前面，就照着说 is long about 900 kilometres。
misconceptions.move: 上下对照写“长 → 900 千米”和“900 kilometres → long”，用箭头标出英语里数量在 long 前面。

misconceptions.name: 说人用了 interesting
misconceptions.why: interesting 学得早，“有趣”“感兴趣”都带“兴趣”，就以为说人也用 interesting。
misconceptions.move: 对比 The map is interesting.（地图有趣）和 He is interested in maps.（他感兴趣），问：感兴趣的是人还是地图？

misconceptions.name: 指人的位置用了动词 invent
misconceptions.why: 汉语“发明”既能说动作也能说东西，就以为 invent 也能直接放在名词的位置上指人。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 a little 后面的空，问：要填一个人还是一个动作？指人用 inventor。

misconceptions.name: 问“在做什么”却答一般现在时
misconceptions.why: 汉语“我在做纸船”和“我做纸船”动词一样，没注意 What are you doing? 问的是此刻正在做的事。
misconceptions.move: 问：Jack 这会儿手里是不是正在做？此刻正在做的事用 am / is / are + -ing。

misconceptions.name: 长词也在词尾加 -er
misconceptions.why: faster、easier 说得多，就把加 -er 的规则用到了 interesting 这样的长词上。
misconceptions.move: 拍手数音节：fast 一拍，in-ter-est-ing 好几拍；长词前面加 more，不再加 -er。

misconceptions.name: 短词的最高级也用 most
misconceptions.why: 读过 one of the most famous，就以为最高级都在前面加 most。
misconceptions.move: 数音节：old 只有一个音节，直接加 -est：the oldest；famous 这样的长词才用 most。

misconceptions.name: should 后面用了 -ing
misconceptions.why: I like reading、I like watching TV 说惯了，就在 should 后面也用 -ing。
misconceptions.move: 对比 I like reading.（喜欢的事）和 You should read.（该做的事），should 后面用原形。

misconceptions.name: 把观点重说一遍当例子
misconceptions.why: 以为例子就是再说一遍自己的看法，没分清观点和能证明它的具体事情。
misconceptions.move: 追问：这句话里发生了一件什么具体的事？说不出来，它就不是例子。

misconceptions.name: 选的例子反倒帮了对方
misconceptions.why: 只看到句子和“读书”有关，没看它在支持哪一方。
misconceptions.move: 把例子接在理由后面连起来读：它能证明这个理由吗，还是在帮对方说话？

misconceptions.name: 看到比较级就当成观点
misconceptions.why: 比较像是在评价，就以为说“更……”的句子都是个人看法。
misconceptions.move: 问：能不能量一量、数一数来核对？能核对的比较是 fact。

misconceptions.name: 把 speak for 当成说外语
misconceptions.why: speak Chinese、speak English 说惯了，看到 speak 后面跟国家就想到语言。
misconceptions.move: 对比 speak English（说英语）和 speak for Japan（代表日本发言），问：for 后面是语言还是国家？

misconceptions.name: 把代表一国当成介绍一国
misconceptions.why: 说到某个国家，最熟的活动是介绍它的名胜和美食，就套了上去。
misconceptions.move: 追问：Model UN 里大家在谈什么？谈世界问题时，他要说的是这个国家的看法。

misconceptions.name: one of 后的名词没用复数
misconceptions.why: 照汉语“之一”只想着说的是一个公园，就用了单数。
misconceptions.move: 问：one of 是从几个里面挑一个？有很多个，后面的名词就加 s。

misconceptions.name: 把有哪些景观当成以什么出名
misconceptions.why: 表里“有什么自然景观”和“以什么出名”挨着，看到景观词就填了进去。
misconceptions.move: 追问：人们专门从远处赶来看的是什么？那才是它出名的东西。

misconceptions.name: 只抓住东西名，没对准难处
misconceptions.why: 看到问题里有“书包”就去改书包，没抓住真正的难处是“太重”。
misconceptions.move: 先圈出问题里的难处 too heavy，再问：这个发明让小朋友背得轻松了吗？

misconceptions.name: 只想发明好看，不管解决什么
misconceptions.why: 以为发明就是做个新奇好看的东西，忘了先问它解决什么问题。
misconceptions.move: 让学生用 It can… 说一说：这个发明能帮小朋友什么忙？

misconceptions.name: 讲做过的事也用说步骤的原形
misconceptions.why: First、Next 后面常跟动词原形教别人做，讲自己已经做完的事时也照搬。
misconceptions.move: 问：这是在教大家做，还是在讲上周已经做完的事？讲过去的事，动词用过去式。

misconceptions.name: 把“有人认为”当成确定的事
misconceptions.why: 只抓住句子里的人名，没注意 Nobody knows for sure 和 Some … think。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 for sure 和 think，问：作者说这件事确定了吗？

misconceptions.name: 把现在的习惯写成计划
misconceptions.why: 计划栏里照着写了自己现在的做法，没用 will 说今后要怎么改。
misconceptions.move: 问：计划说的是以后要怎么做；这句写的是现在还是以后？要改的地方改了吗？

misconceptions.name: 以为天然药物能代替看医生
misconceptions.why: 读到这些东西能让人舒服些，就推得太远，以为生病都不用看医生了。
misconceptions.move: 追问：短文说它们能治好所有的病吗？发高烧时该怎么做？

misconceptions.name: 感叹句用了问句的语序
misconceptions.why: What 开头的句子平时都是问句，就照问句把 is 提到 it 前面。
misconceptions.move: 把感叹句的后半截单独读：it is，和陈述句一样，不是问句的 is it。

misconceptions.name: 照“1 元 = 10 角”换英镑
misconceptions.why: 人民币 1 元换 10 角最熟，就以为 1 pound 也是 10 pence。
misconceptions.move: 回到课文找原句：One pound is ___ pence? 再换算 2 pounds。

misconceptions.name: 把英国的便士说成美国的分
misconceptions.why: 两国的钱都是“100 个小单位换 1 个大单位”，记住了数，混了名称。
misconceptions.move: 列表：美国 dollars / cents，英国 pounds / pence，问：Jack 在哪个国家？

misconceptions.name: 漏看 one of，当成第一个
misconceptions.why: 抓住 first 就译成“第一个”，漏了前面的 one of。
misconceptions.move: 问：one of 是“……之一”，最早来的是一个人还是好几个人？

misconceptions.name: 把 first 读成“先去做”
misconceptions.why: 把 first 当成“首先”，和后面的动作连起来读成“先去……”。
misconceptions.move: 拆开读：Amy 是 one of the first students，to use the new library 说明她们是最早用新图书馆的人。

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: At the school market, Tom gives his old toys to other kids and gets 20 yuan. Tom ____ his old toys.
right: Tom 把玩具给了别人，自己拿到了 20 元，
拿东西换钱是 sell：Tom sells his old toys.
typical: 玩具给了别的小朋友，就是分享：
Tom shares his old toys.

ladder.q: Mum pays 10 yuan and gets some pears. Mum ____ pears. (buys / sells)
Lily puts 5 yuan in her money box every week. She ____ her money. (saves / spends)
用 share 写一句话：把你的蛋糕分给朋友们。
ladder.a: I share my cake with my friends.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：My sister is ten. She always ____ (save) her pocket money in a box.
right: 主语 she 是一个人，说她平时的习惯，
动词加 s：She always saves her pocket money.
typical: always 后面直接写原形：
She always save her pocket money.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Ben always ____ (spend) all his money.
用括号里的词填空：My dad ____ (get) up early every day.
用英语说：我的朋友总是把钱存起来。
ladder.a: My friend always saves his / her money.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: 在文具店问价钱：— ____ these crayons? — ____ 12 yuan.
right: these crayons 是复数：How much are these crayons?
回答也用复数：They're 12 yuan.
typical: How much is 说得最熟，没看 crayons 是复数：
How much is these crayons? It's 12 yuan.

ladder.q: — How much ____ the kite? — It's 18 yuan. (is / are)
— How much are the socks? — ____ 9 yuan.
用英语问这双鞋多少钱，再回答：80 元。
ladder.a: How much are the shoes? They're 80 yuan.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: 讲故事：Many years ago, there ____ an old tree near the river.
right: Many years ago 说的是过去，an old tree 是一棵，
所以用 was：there was an old tree.
typical: “有”就用 have，过去就用 had：
Many years ago, there had an old tree.

ladder.q: 填 was 或 were：Yesterday there ____ a big cake on the table.
填 was 或 were：Last year, there ____ two cats in my garden.
用英语说：从前有一个聪明的小女孩。
ladder.a: Long ago, there was a clever little girl.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.topic: cl 和 cr 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词开头也是 cr 的读音（和 cream 一样）？
right: cream 和 cry 都以 cr 开头，读 /kr/；
clean 开头是 /kl/，car 开头只有 /k/。
typical: clean 和 cream 都是 c 加一个舌头音，
读起来一样

ladder.q: 读一读，说出开头是 cl 还是 cr：clock，cry
找出开头读音不同的词：clever，clothes，crayon
按开头分两组：clothes，cream，clever，cry

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
lessons: Make a plan for your money
items.stem: Mia 有 100 元，打算拿 45 元买一个足球。她向同桌介绍自己的计划，哪一句说对了？
options: I will spend 45 yuan on a football.
I will to spend 45 yuan on a football.
I will spend 45 yuan buy a football.
right: 说计划用 will + 动词原形：I will spend…；
把钱花在什么上：spend + 钱 + on + 东西。
typical: 照“拿 45 元买足球”逐字说：
I will spend 45 yuan buy a football.

ladder.q: 用 save 说计划：我会存 30 元。
填空：I will spend 15 yuan ____ a kite. (on / buy)
你有 50 元，用 spend 和 save 各说一句计划。
ladder.a: 如 I will spend 20 yuan on food. I will save 30 yuan.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: Kate always ____ her pocket money. Now she wants two kites. She asks, “How much ____ they?”
right: Kate 是一个人，说她平时的习惯：Kate always saves…；
two kites 是复数：How much are they?
typical: How much is 说得最顺口，没看 two kites：
How much is they?

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Mike always ____ (spend) his money on toys.
— How much ____ the shoes? — They're 90 yuan.
用英语写两句：Lucy 总是存钱；她问那两本书多少钱。
ladder.a: Lucy always saves her money. How much are the two books?

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: Jack lives in the UK. He has 2 pounds in his pocket. 2 pounds = ____
right: 英国的钱是 pounds 和 pence，1 pound = 100 pence，
所以 2 pounds = 200 pence。cents 是美国的钱。
typical: 照 1 元 = 10 角来换：
2 pounds = 20 pence

ladder.q: How many cents are there in one dollar?
Lucy has 3 pounds. How many pence is that?
Tom has 1 dollar. Amy has 90 cents. Who has more money?

items.stem: 这句话是 fact（事实）还是 opinion（观点）？同意 Lily 的判断吗？
right: 学生人数可以数出来、查得到，谁说都一样，是 fact；
感叹号只表示语气激动，不改变它是事实。

ladder.q: fact 还是 opinion：A week has seven days.
fact 还是 opinion：Maths is very interesting.
关于你的书包，写一句 fact 和一句 opinion。
ladder.a: 如 My bag is blue. / My bag is nice.

items.stem: It's raining. Amy says, “Why not take a bus?” Amy 的意思是：
options: 问别人不坐公交车的原因
right: “Why not + 动词原形……?” 是在提建议，
意思是“何不……呢”：坐公交车去吧。
typical: Why 是“为什么”，所以 Amy 在问：
为什么不坐公交车？

ladder.q: Why not ask your teacher? 是提建议还是问原因？
用 Why not 建议朋友一起去公园。
ladder.a: Why not go to the park together?

ladder.q: 朋友说 I'm tired. 用 Why not 给他提个建议。
ladder.a: 如 Why not go to bed early?

items.stem: 用 interesting 的正确形式填空：In my opinion, stories are ____ than songs.
right: 有 than 要用比较级；interesting 是长词，
前面加 more：more interesting。
typical: 比较级就在词尾加 er：
Stories are interestinger than songs.

ladder.q: 写出比较级：fast → ____，beautiful → ____
用括号里的词填空：Walking is ____ (easy) than running.
用 better 写一句你的观点，比较两种水果。
ladder.a: 如 I think pears are better than apples.

items.stem: Dear Mia, Can I use your green crayon? Tom has my crayons now. Your friend, Leo  这封信是谁写的？
right: 信开头 Dear 后面是收信人 Mia；
结尾 Your friend 下面的 Leo 才是写信人。
typical: 信一开头就写着 Mia，
所以是 Mia 写的

ladder.q: Dear Sam, … Your friend, Kate  这封信写给谁？
Hi Ben, … Love, Grandma  这封信是谁写的？
给同桌写一张便条：写出开头和结尾。
ladder.a: 如 Dear Lily, … Your friend, Wang Hao

items.topic: dr 和 tr 的读音
items.stem: 同意 Tom 的说法吗？
work: Tom：tree 和 drink 开头的读音一样，
因为 t 和 d 读起来差不多。
right: tree 开头是 /tr/，drink 开头是 /dr/，读音不同；
读 d 时喉咙振动，读 t 时不振动。

ladder.q: dr 还是 tr：dream，train
找出开头读音不同的词：drum，draw，try
按开头分两组：drive，trip，drink，tree

items.stem: 辩题 Should students read every day? 你方观点 Yes，理由是 Reading helps us learn new words. 哪一句能作这个理由的例子？
options: I learnt 20 new words from two books.
We think students should read every day.
Some of my friends don't like reading at all.
right: 例子是一件具体的事，要能证明理由：
读两本书学会 20 个新词，正好证明“读书帮我们学新词”。
typical: 选了 We think students should read every day.
这是把观点又说了一遍，不是例子。

ladder.q: 理由：Sport makes us strong. 哪句是例子？a) I run every day and now I'm strong. b) We should do sport.
理由：Pets make people happy. 给它写一个例子。
ladder.a: 如 My cat plays with me and I feel happy.

ladder.q: 辩题 Should we walk to school? 选一方，写一个理由和一个例子。
ladder.a: 如 Yes. Walking is good for us. I walk to school and I feel great.

items.stem: 哪一句是 opinion（观点）？
options: Science is more interesting than maths.
Tom is taller than his brother.
right: “更有趣”是个人感受，有人同意有人不同意，是 opinion；
谁更高、有几间教室，量一量、数一数就能核对，是 fact。
typical: 看到 taller than 在比较，就当成观点：
Tom is taller than his brother.

ladder.q: fact 还是 opinion：My ruler is longer than yours.
fact 还是 opinion：Cats are better than dogs.
用 more beautiful 写一句 opinion。
ladder.a: 如 Spring is more beautiful than winter.

items.stem: In Model UN, Li Ming speaks for Japan. 这句话说的是 Li Ming 要做什么？
options: 向大家介绍日本的名胜和美食
站在日本的立场，就世界问题发表意见
right: speak for a country 是“代表一个国家发言”：
Li Ming 要说出日本对世界问题的看法。
typical: 看到 speak 和 Japan，就以为是说日语：
Li Ming 全程用日语发言。

ladder.q: In Model UN, Tom speaks for the USA. 他代表哪个国家发言？
用英语说：在模拟联合国里，我代表中国发言。
ladder.a: In Model UN, I speak for China.

ladder.q: 在 Model UN 里你想谈什么世界问题？用 I want to talk about… 写一句。
ladder.a: 如 I want to talk about saving animals.

items.stem: This place has lots of sand. It is very hot, and it doesn't often rain. There is no sea or lake. What is it?
right: 沙子多、很热、很少下雨，又没有海和湖：
这是沙漠 a desert。
typical: 看到 sand 就想到海边的沙滩：
a beach

ladder.q: It is a big place with lots of grass. 是哪个词？
There are lots of tall trees here. Many animals live in it. 是哪个词？
用两句英语描述 a beach。
ladder.a: 如 It is next to the sea. It has lots of sand.

items.stem: 用英语说：这条河大约有 900 千米长。
options: The river has about 900 kilometres long.
The river is about 900 kilometres long.
The river is long about 900 kilometres.
right: 说长度：be + 数字 + 单位 + long，
The river is about 900 kilometres long.
typical: 照“长约 900 千米”的顺序说：
The river is long about 900 kilometres.

ladder.q: 用英语说：这座桥长 50 米。
用英语说：那座山高约 1,000 米。
ladder.a: That mountain is about 1,000 metres high.

ladder.q: 用英语问：这条河有多长？再按 300 千米回答。
ladder.a: How long is the river? It's 300 kilometres long.

items.stem: 用 old 的正确形式填空：This tree is 500 years old. It is the ____ tree in our town.
right: 和镇上所有的树比，是“最”老，用最高级；
old 是短词，加 est：the oldest tree。
typical: 比别的树老，就用比较级：
It is the older tree in our town.

ladder.q: 写出最高级：tall → ____，big → ____
用括号里的词填空：Tom is the ____ (fast) runner in our class.
用英语说：这是我们城市最高的楼。
ladder.a: This is the tallest building in our city.

items.stem: 用英语说：我哥哥对地图感兴趣。
options: My brother is interested in maps.
My brother is interesting in maps.
right: 说人“感兴趣”用 interested，前面要有 be：
My brother is interested in maps.
typical: “感兴趣”就是 interesting：
My brother is interesting in maps.

ladder.q: 填 interested 或 interesting：This story is very ____.
用括号里的词填空：Lucy ____ (be) interested in music.
用英语说：我妹妹对恐龙感兴趣。
ladder.a: My sister is interested in dinosaurs.

items.topic: bl 和 br 的读音
items.stem: 哪一组的两个词开头都是 br 的读音，或都是 bl 的读音？
right: brother 和 bring 都以 br 开头，读 /br/；
brown 是 /br/、black 是 /bl/；bed 开头只有 /b/。
typical: brown 和 black 都是 b 加一个舌头音，
读起来一样

ladder.q: bl 还是 br：black，brush
找出开头读音不同的词：brother，brown，blackboard
用 bl、br 开头的词各写一个，并读出来。

items.stem: 为家乡做旅游海报：Stone Bridge is one of ____ in our town.
right: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，old 是短词，最高级是 oldest：
Stone Bridge is one of the oldest bridges in our town.
typical: 说的只是一座桥，就用了单数：
one of the oldest bridge

ladder.q: 选词填空：It is one of the tallest ____ in our park. (tree / trees)
用括号里的词填空：West Hill is one of the ____ (high) hills here.
仿写一句介绍你喜欢的地方：… is one of the most … in …
ladder.a: 如 Moon Lake is one of the most beautiful lakes in our town.

items.stem: — ____ is Moon Mountain? — It's about 2,000 metres high.
right: 答句说的是 2,000 metres high，问的是山有多高：
How high is Moon Mountain? 问河有多长才用 How long。
typical: 看到 metres，就用 How long：
How long is Moon Mountain?

ladder.q: — ____ is the river? — It's about 500 kilometres long.
— How high is the hill? — It's about 300 metres ____.
就 Blue Lake 问一个问题并回答：湖深约 50 米。
ladder.a: How deep is Blue Lake? It's about 50 metres deep.

items.stem: 读公园介绍，填表中的 What is it famous for? 同意 Tom 的填法吗？
work: Moon Park has lakes, hills and forests.
Every autumn, people come to see its red leaves.
Tom：It is famous for its lakes, hills and forests.
right: lakes, hills and forests 是公园里有的自然景观；
人们每年秋天专门来看红叶：It is famous for its red leaves.

ladder.q: Star Lake is famous for its blue water. 它以什么出名？
Sun Park has rivers. Every spring, people come to see its flowers. 它以什么出名？
用 famous for 介绍你家乡的一个地方。
ladder.a: 如 Our town is famous for its old bridge.

items.stem: Lily makes a robot. It can clean the floor for her grandma. Lily is a little ____.
right: 空里说的是 Lily 这个人：发明的人是 inventor；
invention 是发明出来的东西，invent 是动词。
typical: 机器人是发明，Lily 就是 invention：
Lily is a little invention.

ladder.q: 填 inventor 或 invention：The robot is a great ____.
用英语说：她想成为一名发明家。
ladder.a: She wants to be an inventor.

ladder.q: 用 invention 写一句话，说说你喜欢的发明。
ladder.a: 如 The phone is a great invention.

items.stem: — What are you doing, Jack? — I ____ a paper boat for my little sister.
right: 问的是“现在正在做什么”，用现在进行时：
am + making：I am making a paper boat.
typical: “正在做”就是 making：
I making a paper boat.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Look! Tom is ____ (draw) a bird.
用括号里的词填空：— What are they doing? — They ____ (water) the flowers.
用英语问妈妈在做什么，再替她答：在做蛋糕。
ladder.a: What are you doing, Mum? I'm making a cake.

items.stem: 做贺卡：First, cut a piece of paper. Next, ____ a flower on it. Then, write “Happy birthday”.
right: 说步骤用祈使句，动词放在句首、用原形：
Next, draw a flower on it.
typical: 手工正在一步步做，就用 -ing：
Next, drawing a flower on it.

ladder.q: 改成说步骤的样子：washes your hands → ____
用 First、Next 写两步：洗苹果，切苹果。
ladder.a: First, wash the apples. Next, cut them.

ladder.q: 用 First、Next、Then、Last 写出做三明治的四步。
ladder.a: 如 First, put some bread on a plate. …

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Last Sunday, Grandpa ____ (cut) some bamboo to make a kite.
right: Last Sunday 说的是过去；cut 的过去式不变，
还是 cut：Grandpa cut some bamboo.
typical: 过去式就在词尾加 ed：
Grandpa cutted some bamboo.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：put → ____，see → ____
用括号里的词填空：Yesterday I ____ (put) my book on the desk.
用英语说：上周我们做了一把扇子。
ladder.a: We made a fan last week.

items.topic: fr 和 fl 的拼写
items.stem: 用 fr 或 fl 补全单词：My best ___iend lives next to me.
right: friend 开头读 /fr/，拼作 fr：
My best friend lives next to me.
typical: fr 和 fl 读起来差不多，
写成 fliend

ladder.q: fr 还是 fl：___uit（水果）
fr 还是 fl：Look at the red ___owers!
按开头分两组：Friday，flower，fruit，flag

items.stem: Problem: The school bags are too heavy for little kids. 哪个发明能解决这个问题？
options: A bag with many colours. It looks nice.
A bigger bag. You can put more books in it.
A bag with wheels. It moves easily.
right: 难处是书包太重、小朋友背不动；
装上轮子拉着走，就不用背着：A bag with wheels.
typical: 只看到“书包”，就想把书包做得更大：
A bigger bag. You can put more books in it.

ladder.q: Grandpa can't read small words. 哪个有用：a phone with big words 还是 a phone with many colours？
Problem: Our classroom floor is often dirty. 用 It can… 说一个发明的用处。
ladder.a: 如 It can clean the floor fast.

ladder.q: 说一个身边的问题，再用 This is our… It can… 介绍你们的发明。
ladder.a: 如 This is our light pen. It can help us write at night.

items.topic: 讲做法：原形还是过去式
items.stem: Lily 讲她上周日怎样做玩具车，用括号里的词填空：Last Sunday I made a toy car. First, I ____ (find) a small box.
right: Last Sunday 说明讲的是已经做完的事，动词用过去式；
find 是不规则动词，过去式是 found。
typical: 看到 First，就用说步骤时的原形：
First, I find a small box.

ladder.q: 教同学做手工，用括号里的词填空：First, ____ (cut) the paper.
讲昨天做的事，用括号里的词填空：Then I ____ (make) a paper bird.
用 First 和 Then 讲你做过的一件手工（两句）。
ladder.a: 如 First, I found some paper. Then I made a paper box.

items.stem: 读下面关于学校花园的介绍，同意 Tom 的说法吗？
work: Our school garden is very old. Who made it?
Nobody knows for sure. Some teachers think it was Mr Wang.
Tom：It may be Mr Wang, but nobody is sure.
right: Nobody knows for sure 说明谁也不能确定；
Some teachers think 只是一部分人的看法，所以 Tom 说得对。

ladder.q: Some people think it was Lily. 这件事确定吗？
ladder.a: 不确定，只是有些人这样想

ladder.q: No one knows for sure who made the kite. 谁做的这只风筝，大家清楚吗？
用 We don't know for sure 和 Some people think 写两句话。
ladder.a: 如 We don't know for sure. Some people think it was Tom.

items.stem: 用英语说：她牙疼。
right: 说得了什么病用 have，主语 she 用 has；
牙疼是 toothache：She has a toothache.
typical: 汉语“她牙疼”里没有“有”，就用 is：
She is a toothache.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我头疼。
用英语说：他发烧了。
用英语说：我妹妹咳嗽，还喉咙疼。
ladder.a: My sister has a cough and a sore throat.

items.stem: Put on your coat. It's very cold today. You may have a cough tomorrow. 句中 may 的意思是：
right: 这里不是允许你咳嗽，而是说一种可能：
不穿外套，明天可能会咳嗽。
typical: May I …? 是“我可以……吗”，
所以 may 就是“可以”

ladder.q: May I open the window? 句中 may 是什么意思？
It's cloudy. It may rain. 句中 may 是什么意思？
用 may 说一句：你可能会牙疼。

items.stem: — What's the matter with Tom? — He has a fever. — He should ____ to bed early.
right: should 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to，
主语是 he 也不加 s：He should go to bed early.
typical: want to、need to 说惯了：
He should to go to bed early.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：You should ____ (see) a doctor.
— I have a toothache. — You ____ eat too many sweets. (should / shouldn't)
朋友说 I have a cough. 用 should 给他两条建议。
ladder.a: 如 You should see a doctor and go to bed early.

items.stem: Ben 想提醒弟弟爱护眼睛，写了下面这句话。同意他的写法吗？
work: You don't should play computer games at night.
right: should 的否定是在后面加 not：shouldn't，
You shouldn't play computer games at night.

ladder.q: 改成否定句：You should eat lots of sweets.
ladder.a: You shouldn't eat lots of sweets.

ladder.q: 填 should 或 shouldn't：You ____ sit too close to the TV.
为保护眼睛，写一句 should 和一句 shouldn't。
ladder.a: 如 I should sleep early. I shouldn't …

items.topic: gl 和 gr 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词开头也是 gr 的读音（和 grow 一样）？
right: grow 和 green 都以 gr 开头，读 /gr/；
glue 开头是 /gl/，good 开头只有 /g/。
typical: glue 和 grow 都是 g 加一个舌头音，
读起来一样

ladder.q: gl 还是 gr：glad，grape
找出开头读音不同的词：grass，glass，grandma
按开头分两组：great，glue，green，glad

items.stem: Tom often goes to bed at eleven, and he is tired in class. 他的健康计划 Sleep 一栏写哪句？
options: I go to bed at eleven.
I'll goes to bed at nine.
I'll go to bed at nine.
right: 计划说以后要做的事：I'll（= I will）+ 动词原形；
早点睡才能解决上课犯困：I'll go to bed at nine.
typical: 照着自己现在的作息写：
I go to bed at eleven.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：I'll ____ (drink) more water every day.
用 I'll 为自己写一句 Eat 计划。
Amy watches TV for three hours every day. 替她写一句 Do 计划。
ladder.a: 如 I'll play outside after school.

items.stem: — What's the matter with Tom? — He ____ a fever. — He should ____ in bed.
right: 说生病用 have / has + 病名，Tom 是三单：He has a fever.
should 后面用动词原形：He should stay in bed.
typical: 照“他发烧了”，用 is 把人和病连起来：
He is a fever.

ladder.q: — What's the matter? — I ____ a cough. (have / am)
用括号里的词填空：She has a cold. She should ____ (drink) more water.
Your friend has a bad cough. 用 should 给他一条建议。
ladder.a: 如 You should take some medicine.

items.stem: 读完 Let’s explore 的短文 Natural medicines，哪一句说出了短文的主要意思？
options: Some natural medicines are in the park.
There are many natural medicines around us.
With them, we never need to go to the doctor.
right: 短文说天然药物可以在公园、花园、厨房里找到，
又举了几种例子，合起来讲的是：我们身边有很多天然药物。
typical: 只记住了“在公园里”这一处：
Some natural medicines are in the park.

ladder.q: Walking is good for us. It makes our legs strong. It helps us sleep well. 哪句是主要意思？
Milk is good for us. Fish is good for us. Eggs are good for us. 用一句话说主要意思。
ladder.a: 如 Many foods are good for us.

ladder.q: Amy has a bad fever. 她只喝点天然药茶、不去看医生，行吗？为什么？
ladder.a: 不行，天然药物不能代替看医生

items.stem: 哪一句是对的？
options: We went to UK last year.
We went to the Canada last year.
We went to the UK last year.
right: the UK 是固定说法，前面要有 the；
Canada、France、Italy 前面不加 the。
typical: 国家名前面都不加 the：
We went to UK last year.

ladder.q: 填 the 或不填：My uncle lives in ____ France.
填 the 或不填：London is in ____ UK.
用英语说：我想去澳大利亚和英国。
ladder.a: I want to go to Australia and the UK.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Last Saturday, my aunt ____ (take) me to the zoo.
right: Last Saturday 说的是过去的事；
take 的过去式是 took：my aunt took me to the zoo.
typical: 过去式就在词尾加 ed：
My aunt taked me to the zoo.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：see → ____，go → ____
用括号里的词填空：We ____ (have) a walk by the river yesterday.
用英语说：昨天爸爸带我去了公园。
ladder.a: Dad took me to the park yesterday.

items.topic: What a 和 How 感叹句
items.stem: 看到同学画的画，你说：____ clever girl she is!
right: clever girl 是“形容词 + 单数名词”，
用 What a 开头：What a clever girl she is!
typical: 看到形容词 clever 就用 How：
How clever girl she is!

ladder.q: 填 What 或 How：____ big the room is!
填 What 或 What a：____ nice day it is!
用 How 改写：What a tall tree it is!

items.stem: It's going to rain, so I won't ride my bike tomorrow. 句中 won't 是哪两个词的缩写？
right: won't = will not，说将来不会做某事：
明天要下雨，我明天不骑车了。
typical: won't 和 want 长得像，
就以为是“不想”：want not

ladder.q: 写出缩写：will not → ____，do not → ____
用 won't 改写：I will not be late again.
用 won't 说一句：明天你不会做的一件事。
ladder.a: 如 I won't watch TV tomorrow.

items.topic: pl 和 pr 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词里有 pr 的读音（和 pretty 开头一样）？
right: April 中间的 pr 读 /pr/，和 pretty 开头一样；
play 开头是 /pl/，pet 开头只有 /p/。
typical: play 和 pretty 都是 p 加一个舌头音，
读起来一样

ladder.q: pl 还是 pr：plate，present
找出含 pr 读音的词：April，apple，pen
按开头分两组：plate，pretty，plane，present

items.stem: 给外地朋友写家乡介绍，想说“家乡的橘子很有名”。哪一句写对了？
options: Oranges is famous in my hometown.
Oranges are famous in my hometown.
right: oranges 是复数，be 动词用 are：
Oranges are famous in my hometown.
typical: 照“橘子很有名”逐字说，漏了 be：
Oranges famous in my hometown.

ladder.q: 选词填空：The old bridge ____ famous in my hometown. (is / are)
选词填空：Dumplings ____ famous in my hometown. (is / are)
用 … is / are famous in my hometown. 介绍家乡的一样东西。
ladder.a: 如 The tea is famous in my hometown.

items.stem: 讲去年的旅行：Last summer we ____ to Sanya. What a beautiful beach ____!
right: Last summer 说的是过去，go 的过去式是 went；
感叹句 What a + 形容词 + 名词 + 主语 + 动词：… it is!
typical: 照问句把 is 提到 it 前面：
What a beautiful beach is it!

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Yesterday I ____ (see) a tall tower.
连词成句（感叹句）：nice / what / a / is / it / day
ladder.a: What a nice day it is!

ladder.q: 用一句过去时和一句感叹句讲你的一次旅行。
ladder.a: 如 Last year I went to Beijing. What a big city it is!

items.topic: one of the first 的意思
items.stem: Amy was one of the first students to use the new library. 这句话是什么意思？
options: 她是第一个用新图书馆的学生
她是最早用新图书馆的学生之一
她先去了新图书馆，再去别的地方
right: one of the first … to … 是“最早……的那批人之一”；
不是说只有她第一个，也不是说她先去哪儿。
typical: 看到 first 就译成“第一个”：
她是第一个用新图书馆的学生。

ladder.q: He was the first student to come to school today. 他是第几个到校的？
She was one of the first girls to join the club. 她是唯一最先加入的人吗？
ladder.a: 不是，她是最早加入的几个女孩之一

ladder.q: 用 one of the first 写一句：Tom 是最早到校的学生之一。
ladder.a: Tom was one of the first students to come to school.
